name: Media Vote
overview: Let your users vote on which movies and shows to remove.
description: An administrator calls a vote among selected Jellyfin users. Users vote from a banner at the top of their home page, a Vote tab (Custom Tabs), a sidebar page (Plugin Pages) or a standalone page. At the deadline the top N titles are either reported to the admin (default) or deleted with their files by Sonarr (series) or Radarr (movies). Media Vote itself never deletes or changes a media file.

versions.changelog: 1.0.2.0. Deletion now goes only through Sonarr and Radarr: Media Vote never deletes, moves or changes a media file (Jellyfin cannot write to exFAT drives). "Delete automatically" became "Delete via Sonarr/Radarr": winners are matched by provider ids, deleted with deleteFiles=true, verified gone, and Jellyfin forgets them once their files are gone. Several Sonarr/Radarr/Jellyseerr instances; titles they do not manage are marked and left out of delete votes by default; read-only dry run with the exact entries and GB; maximum titles per vote; Sonarr/Radarr state on the Status tab. Fixes the vote-results banner coming back after it was closed. Requires Jellyfin 10.11.10.
